claims.claim: p=2 is the unique universal exponent in Lp exchange of complementary-minor orientation vectors; two exact 6x6 integer counterexamples cover 0<p<2 and 2<p<=infinity.
claims.details: Independent exact minors reproduce endpoint and neighbor magnitude lists. Symbolic inequalities 2^(2/p)>2 for p<2 and 4>2^(1+2/p) for p>2 prove entire ranges. p<1 uses a quasi-norm but the displayed functional is well-defined. p=2 is inherited baseline exchange.
claims.baseline_overlap: New counterexamples relative to three frozen Sol reports; general Hilbert exchange is inherited.
claims.sources: p=2 premise: already-audited stability/exchange baseline; new negative ranges use exact determinant expansion only. Priority UNKNOWN.
claims.cost: Constant-size integer minors <=3; no counting/sampling oracle, general energy comparison, or general entropy impossibility.

claims.claim: L1 and L-infinity exchange failures persist with all 15 coordinate-pair auxiliaries at activity 10^-4.
claims.details: Coordinate-column expansion forces selected auxiliary pairs to form matchings. Labels are distinct, so no interference is combined across matchings. L1 numbers independently recomputed over all 76 matchings; L-infinity formula follows from the same expansion and reported maximum base amplitude two.

claims.claim: Unitary rational weak-block F fixes diagonal DPP leverages and Gram normalizer while hard two-hole ratios grow exponentially in encoded small parameter; rejection and independent signed determinant estimators have exponential precision cost.
claims.details: Checked orthogonality and complementary minors at L=2,6,10; all16 sign determinants independently enumerated at each L. Character orthogonality plus Cauchy-Binet proves the general signed formula. Optimal independent importance-sampling second moment is bounded below by the squared absolute sum by Cauchy-Schwarz.

No lower bound against algorithms that read the off-diagonal kernel or original block parameter follows.

claims.cost: Theta(2^(2L)) rejection trials, relative signed second moment Theta(2^(4L)); fixed-dimensional instance itself is exactly easy.

claims.claim: Given acquired symmetric positive-support G_ij=f(ij)/f(empty), the geometric program minimizing sum exp x_i with x_i+x_j>=log G_ij has a unique solution with all scaled row maxima one; upward factor-two rounding keeps them in [1/4,1].
claims.details: Congruence law uses x_i=log d_i^2, so g'ij=Gij/(exp xi exp xj). Finite objective sublevel bounds xi above, incident positive constraints bound below. Strict convexity and Slater apply. KKT makes each row incident to a tight edge. Rounding products increases them by at most four.
repairs: The proof establishes existence and bit dynamic range, not an implemented/certified polynomial-time numerical solver.
Rows with no positive entry cannot meet a positive lower bound.

Rounding t_i=d_i^2 to dyadics alone can leave d_i irrational. For rational F congruence use the upward rational grid {1,5/4,3/2,7/4}*2^m; adjacent ratio <=5/4 gives ttilde_i/t_i<=25/16<2 with the same O(B+log n) bits. Sent this repair to origin worker.
claims.baseline_overlap: Useful precise post-acquisition lemma; missing ratio acquisition remains unchanged. Score does not credit general balance gate closure.
claims.sources: Elementary convex/KKT argument; no external algorithm is executed. Priority UNKNOWN.
claims.cost: Needs exact O(n^2) ratio inputs. Rounded coordinates O(B+log n) bits given B-bit G. Solver precision/cost not supplied.

claims.claim: For 4-site hard-BCS endpoint exchange, all three positive matching terms imply strict inequality.
claims.details: Six complementary minors decompose into three signed matching vectors. Each matching contributes its four directed products exactly once, norm sqrt(g_e g_e'). Common proportional vector in triangle equality would vanish on three disjoint zero-coordinate pairs covering all six coordinates. Thus it is zero, contradicting positivity. Independent coefficient-specific bound f(empty)<=2 sum matching products excludes the symmetric equality vector.
repairs: Only n=4 S=E,T=empty is proved; no extension to arbitrary shared core or larger dimension.
